- Native preset version: `1.5.3.5`.

## Processor rules

- Source validation requires a JSON object with non-empty `name`, string `version`, non-empty string-list `filament_settings_id`, and non-empty string `inherits`. A non-`User` `from` value is rejected as an unsupported material preset. Unknown fields are accepted.
- Canonicalization deep-copies the source, sets `name = f"{context.pi_code} @{context.printer}"`, and sets `pm_method_version = context.pm_method_version`.
- The intentional semantic mutation set is exactly `name` and `pm_method_version`.
- `filament_settings_id`, `inherits`, `from`, native `version`, `filament_extruder_variant`, all unknown fields, and all tested material/printing parameters are preserved.
- ElegooSlicer may remove `pm_method_version` on external re-export; Worker re-injects the authoritative context value on every canonicalization.
- Serialization is UTF-8 indented JSON with filename `f"{context.pi_code} @{context.printer}.json"` and media type `application/json`.

## UnifiedDiff

The processor uses the existing `UnifiedDiff` contract with `ADDED`, `REMOVED`, and `MODIFIED` changes, including missing/null distinctions and deterministic path ordering.

- `fan_cooling_layer_time`, `fan_min_speed`, `filament_extruder_variant`, `nozzle_temperature`, and `nozzle_temperature_initial_layer` are `IMPORTANT_PARAMETER`.
- `name`, `filament_settings_id`, `inherits`, `from`, `version`, and `pm_method_version` are `SYSTEM_METADATA`.
- Unknown fields are emitted as `OTHER_PARAMETER`; no changes are silently dropped.
